cross_problem_equivalence_classes.shared_structure: locally meaningful components do not generate the target interaction after composition/projection

cross_problem_equivalence_classes.advisory: require a strict-reduction or premise-discharge witness for every representation change
cross_problem_equivalence_classes.disanalogy: Hodge equivalence is verified in a scoped first-order setting; BSD is only a bounded applicability audit
cross_problem_equivalence_classes.shared_structure: a new representation restates or imports the hard obligation instead of reducing it

failure_mechanisms.failed_inference: more semantic objects or quotient types were expected to force additive cover resources
failure_mechanisms.falsifier: before enumerating later targets, prove or refute a family-wide support-overlap invariant and then exhibit a reused active row and reused active column that cannot be separated by the prior multiplexing construction
failure_mechanisms.method: derive growing cover complexity from accumulating semantic UNSAT structure in a one-sided recursive language
failure_mechanisms.proximate_cause: the representation kept old and new support either component-separable or in disjoint row/column projections, allowing cover multiplexing; the later family-wide half-space invariant makes the desired canonical row collision impossible in the frozen orientation
failure_mechanisms.repair: change the family/orientation only through an exact DifferenceWitness that creates bidirectional old/new support coupling while preserving the language and lower-bound target
failure_mechanisms.root_cause: missing mathematical interaction in the chosen representation, not insufficient enumeration depth
scope: exact frozen C041 one-sided recursion through the C046 invariant
does not rule out mirrored, two-sided, or different encodings
does not establish a lower bound

failure_mechanisms.failed_inference: agreement/convergence/positivity of the representation was treated as faithful transport of the root property
failure_mechanisms.falsifier: construct two admissible global objects with the same registered finite/proxy observations but different root property, or prove a domain-uniform zero-transport/no-pollution theorem that rules such pairs out
failure_mechanisms.method: infer global zero geometry or Li positivity from finite prefixes, convergent operator proxies, or a manifestly positive norm surrogate
failure_mechanisms.proximate_cause: finite or strong-resolvent information permits spectral pollution, wandering modes, joint-limit ambiguity, and off-critical completions; the Suzuki norm-to-Li identification reaches an RH-equivalent premise before faithfulness is obtained
failure_mechanisms.repair: require an explicit injectivity/faithfulness theorem at the exact infinite-object topology before treating proxy positivity or convergence as root evidence
failure_mechanisms.root_cause: the observation map is non-identifying for the root coordinate unless a separate global faithfulness/no-pollution theorem is proved
scope: registered finite-prefix, Galerkin, strong-resolvent, joint-limit, and Suzuki-norm routes
does not rule out faithful spectral or analytic representations

failure_mechanisms.failed_inference: fixed-observer convergence and coarse scale-normalized bounds were assumed to control absolute mass, geometry, or pressure at sequence-dependent scales
failure_mechanisms.falsifier: translated divergence-free bump and packet constructions attack the bare transfer; a PDE-specific uniform annular-tail/pressure modulus would falsify their applicability to the solution class
failure_mechanisms.method: transport local compactness, topology, or normalized energy control to a moving-scale regularity quantity
failure_mechanisms.proximate_cause: translation, packet multiplicity, pressure tails, and intermediate annuli remain invisible to the registered local topology/normalization
failure_mechanisms.repair: derive a scale-aligned uniform tail/rate modulus or replace the route with a signed/telescoping identity that controls the moving QoI directly
failure_mechanisms.root_cause: scale mismatch in the observation map; whether Navier-Stokes dynamics supplies the missing modulus remains open
scope: functional transfer logic and registered NS atoms
not an NSE/Euler counterexample or impossibility theorem

failure_mechanisms.failed_inference: separately valid ingredients were treated as if they acted on one invariant, dense source class in one reconstructed theory
failure_mechanisms.falsifier: in one fixed theory bind the OS quotient vector, exact translated moment identity, source-independent decay rate, and dense/cyclic excited subspace; failure of any witness rejects the composition only
failure_mechanisms.method: compose local operator closure, reflection positivity, covariance decay, and source completeness into a spectral-gap inference
failure_mechanisms.proximate_cause: operator elimination proliferates geometry; restricted sources can miss hidden states; exact covariance-to-transfer moments and post-null-quotient density for the same controlled class are unbound
failure_mechanisms.repair: construct a common invariant graded source space and prove both closure under the dynamics and density after quotient/completion before spectral exclusion
failure_mechanisms.root_cause: missing same-object/same-algebra/same-measure interface witnesses; evidence does not decide missing theorem versus genuine obstruction
scope: not a Yang-Mills no-go or continuum mass-gap claim

failure_mechanisms.failed_inference: a reformulation of liftability was treated as an easier mechanism
failure_mechanisms.falsifier: exhibit a detector or higher-order invariant whose target obligation is strictly weaker than lift existence but still implies the required algebraic continuation
failure_mechanisms.method: replace first-order branch lifting by same-detector annihilation or direct obstruction vanishing
failure_mechanisms.proximate_cause: under complete first-order obstruction semantics, vanishing on the tangent branch is equivalent to the original lift statement; the same detector cannot recover information deliberately killed by Hodge persistence
failure_mechanisms.repair: change detector/order/geometry with an explicit strict-reduction proof, rather than rename the original obligation
failure_mechanisms.root_cause: no reduction in mathematical complexity and no new identifying coordinate
scope: fixed witness, registered first-order branch and complete-obstruction fork
does not cover higher-order or other detectors

failure_mechanisms.failed_inference: a new Euler-system, Kolyvagin, plectic, Selmer, or Heegner representation was assumed to derive the required arithmetic entry condition
failure_mechanisms.falsifier: produce a same-E/Q theorem starting only from exact complex analytic rank two and proving root-faithful Selmer dimension plus nonzero transverse localization without importing equivalent arithmetic strength
failure_mechanisms.method: change arithmetic carrier to transport exact complex analytic rank two into nonvanishing/localization and full BSD data
failure_mechanisms.proximate_cause: audited theorems are downstream of, or explicitly assume, a main-conjecture/nonvanishing/localization/Selmer-rank/regulator premise not supplied by complex analytic rank two
failure_mechanisms.repair: demand an explicit complex-to-arithmetic comparison theorem and a separate full-leading-term gluing chain; do not reverse downstream implications
failure_mechanisms.root_cause: representation change relocates rather than closes the analytic-to-arithmetic bridge; no global theorem-nonexistence is established
scope: four audited source families and exact same E/Q scope
not a blacklist or BSD counterexample

object: Cross-Millennium mathematical failure mechanisms and supported causes, excluding software assurance as mathematical progress.
quantity_of_interest: Which exact mathematical inference failed, why/how it failed at the strongest supported causal level, and what cheapest mathematical discriminator or repair follows?

self_rakl_feedback.activation: after a material mathematical candidate failure or repeated residual, before selecting the next representation or transfer
self_rakl_feedback.falsifier: On frozen matched mathematical failure cases, reject or narrow the compiler if it does not improve valid next-action selection and repeat-failure avoidance at matched resources, if it labels an observed failure as a unique cause without evidence, or if it suppresses a viable route.
non_activation: cases already closed by a verified proof certificate
predicted_benefit: reduce repeated proxy optimization when identification is missing
detect premise reimport and representation-equivalent reformulations
prioritize family-wide invariant tests and shared-interface witnesses
self_rakl_feedback.proposed_method_delta: Add a mathematical failure-cause compiler that maps each failed inference to (source facts, attempted implication, minimal countermodel or missing witness, supported causal level, exact scope, cheapest mathematical falsifier, repair obligation). Route by supported cause rather than file/test failure.
risks: reflection overhead without better next actions
